title: Meow header
description: A fixed 65px top bar: orange-icon wordmark, five plain nav items with hover drop-down panels, a ghost sign-in and a small orange button. It lies see-through with white text over the dark hero and turns white with ink text and a hairline once the page scrolls or the pointer rests on it. Phones get a menu button that opens a full-width panel.
notes: `overDark` (on by default) makes the resting bar transparent with the theme's dark tokens, for pages that open with a dark hero
`position="fixed"` by default: give the first section 65px of top padding (meow-hero does)
needs JavaScript for the scroll/hover colour change and the phone menu
name: meow-header

props.name: nav
